question: What identity should an external service be able to verify, and which outbound request owners may emit that proof?
rationale: Code inspection cannot choose among materially different issuer, enrollment, key-custody, revocation, privacy, replay, and cross-domain tracking tradeoffs.

options.title: Service-enrolled identity
options.body: Use per-service or per-operator keys with explicit audience and domain scope through a narrow plugin-owned request path.

options.title: Global OpenClaw issuer
options.body: Create project-wide signing, verification, rotation, revocation, and anti-replay infrastructure for selected outbound stacks.

options.title: Service-specific authentication only
options.body: Keep authentication in each plugin or service through API keys or OAuth without making a general OpenClaw identity claim.

recommendation.title: Service-enrolled identity
recommendation.body: Use per-service or per-operator keys with explicit audience and domain scope through a narrow plugin-owned request path.
